title: READQ TD: destructive FIFO read of an intrapartition queue (oldest first, the read destroys the record), QZERO on an empty or drained queue, QIDERR on an undefined queue (READQ / WRITEQ / DELETEQ), DELETEQ TD then READQ, LENGERR on a short INTO area

scenarios.summary: WRITEQ TD of items of 5, 7 and 8 bytes, then READQ TD x4 into an 8-byte area: oldest first, each read destroys its record (5, 7, 8 bytes), the fourth is QZERO; the queue ends empty
HCQ1 starts with one item; WRITEQ TD appends a second; READQ TD returns the seeded item first, then the written one, then QZERO
READQ TD of an empty queue: QZERO, the INTO area is not written
READQ TD, WRITEQ TD and DELETEQ TD of HCNQ, a queue the CSD does not define: QIDERR each
WRITEQ TD of three items, DELETEQ TD of the queue, then READQ TD: the data is gone, QZERO
an 8-byte item read into a 4-byte area with LENGTH(4): LENGERR, the first 4 bytes are moved and LENGTH comes back 8
